description: Ranked search across the project. Lexical (BM25) by default; optional semantic (vector) and hybrid (RRF fusion) modes available when the @xenova/transformers peer dependency is installed. Scope controls what to search: "auto"/"content" (ranked content matches with excerpts), "symbols" (exported names), "files" (path substring).

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

mode.description: "lexical" (default, BM25) | "semantic" (embeddings, requires peer dep) | "hybrid" (BM25 + semantic via reciprocal rank fusion). Ignored for "symbols" and "files" scopes.

package.description: Optional. Workspace package name (from projscan_workspaces) to scope results to one package only.

query.description: Search string. Multi-word queries are treated as OR across BM25 terms; semantic mode embeds the full query.

sub_file.description: 0.15.0+: when true, build the semantic index per-function instead of per-file (where the language adapter extracted functions). Hits return a `function` field with name + line range. Ignored in lexical mode. Default false.

name: projscan_search
